description.value:
The forgiven are a beast tribe born from the ashes of the ancient sin-eaters, spiritually redeemed and now living beings warped by primordial light.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Forgiven gain +2 Wisdom and +2 Charisma.
  • Type: Forgiven are outsiders with the native subtype.
  • Size: Forgiven are Medium creatures.
  • Base Speed: Forgiven have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Forgiven begin play speaking Common and Celestial. Forgiven with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Mithran, Sylvan and Vieran.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Celestial Resistance: Forgiven have holy resistance 5, ice resistance 5, and lightning resistance 5.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Skill Bonus: Forgiven have a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Perception checks.

Magical Racial Traits

  • Spell-Like Ability (Sp): Forgiven can use daylight once per day as a spell-like ability.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Darkvision: Forgiven have darkvision 60 ft.
